bio: In the heart of the Mercantour National Park, between the valleys of the Tinée River and Vésubie River, a duo with a longing for nature set their sights on this traditional stone-built inn. The calm beauty of the surrounding countryside won them over, as it will you, too. Our hosts serve a single set menu of natural, creative cuisine with a strong vegetable component, as well as local produce (including from their kitchen garden). There is a good selection of natural beers and wines....
